detail.title: Mechanisms for Autonomous Problem Formulation and Cognitive Evolution
detail.summary: Autonomous discovery in agents relies on both curiosity for motivation and discrepancy-driven evaluation for validation. Integrating these mechanisms allows agents to adapt their reasoning and learning methods rather than relying on fixed structures, enabling better handling of novel research problems and environmental changes.
detail.reason: Updating the notebook to incorporate mechanisms for long-term cognitive adaptation and validation.

detail.title: Mechanisms for Autonomous Problem Formulation
